data.title: Texas Family Care Network Names Rocky Hensarling CEO as Organization Expands Community-Based Care Leadership
data.description: In Dallas, Texas Family Care Network (TFCN) under Pressley Ridge has appointed Rocky Hensarling as the new Chief Executive Officer. Hensarling will oversee Community-Based Care in Region 5 (Deep East Texas) and Region 3E (Metroplex East). With over 15 years of experience working with Texas children and families, including a significant leadership background at the Texas Department of Family and Protective Services (DFPS), Hensarling's appointment comes as a strategic move for TFCN. His expertise in the field will prove valuable in furthering TFCN's mission.

data.title: Electra Receives Extension from NASDAQ to Resolve Minimum Price Requirement
data.description: On September 15, 2026, Electra Battery Materials Corporation revealed that it has been granted an extension until March 15, 2027, by The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC to meet the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement for continued listing on Nasdaq. The company's stock trades under the ticker symbols ELBM on NASDAQ and ELBM on TSX-V. This extension gives Electra an additional 180-calendar-day period to comply with the Minimum Bid Price Requirement.

The distribution is slated for disbursement on or before October 15, 2026, to shareholders recorded as of September 30, 2026.

data.title: A Richardson Staple Returns! Dickey’s Barbecue Pit Reopens Longstanding Location Under New Ownership
data.description: A beloved barbecue restaurant, Dickey’s Barbecue Pit, has reopened its doors at 2160 N. Coit Road in Richardson, TX 75080. This location, situated in the Lennox Center shopping and dining area, has been a staple in the community since 2014, catering to families, students, and local businesses. Known for its slow-smoked meats and warm hospitality, Dickey’s is back to serve its loyal customers in the neighborhood. The reopening took place on September 16, marking a return to the area by bringing back a favorite spot for residents.

data.description: Attorneys Susan Estrich of Estrich Goldin and Aaron Cutler of Hogan Lovells Cadwalader, representing Leon Black, submitted letters to Chairman James Comer, Ranking Member Robert Garcia, and the Committee on Oversight and Government Reform in Washington.
